description: Rede ciclável do Seixal is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município do Seixal . Existing cycling network and proposal of the municipality of Seixal. Coverage: Município do Seixal . The portal shows the English title as "Seixal Cycling Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município do Seixal . Its keywords include rede-ciclavel. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2025-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
